console.agents.title: Agent definitions
console.agents.lede: What each agent is told to do, version by version, and how bleqq's own agents run.
console.agents.errorTitle: Could not load the agent definitions
console.agents.emptyBody: A definition appears here once its folder is in the repository and the build has loaded it.
console.agents.notFoundBody: No agent definition has this key.
console.agents.detailErrorTitle: Could not load this agent definition
console.agents.versionsNote: A run keeps the version it started under, so earlier runs still name the version that made them.
console.agents.noVersionBody: Publish the first version when its folder is in the repository.
console.agents.publishNote: Publishing asks for your passkey. Runs that start after it use the new version.
console.agents.versionHint: The number of a version folder in the repository that is not published yet.
console.agents.versionRequired: Enter the number of the version to publish.
console.agents.changeNoteHint: Shown beside the version for as long as it exists.
console.agents.changeNoteRequired: Say what changed in this version.
console.agents.publishedStatus: Published. {name} runs version {version} from its next run.
console.agents.retireBody: Retire version {version}? No run starts on it again. The runs it made keep naming it, and it stays in this list. Retiring asks for your passkey.
console.agents.retiredStatus: Retired version {version}. No run starts on it again.
console.agents.tenantSettingsNote: A definition for banks has no settings here: each bank sets its own agent's cadence, scope and cap.
console.agents.settings.title: How it runs
console.agents.settings.budgetHint: When it is reached, the next scheduled run waits for the new month. Leave it empty for no budget.
console.agents.settings.budgetInvalid: Enter an amount in euro, such as 250 or 250.00.
console.agents.settings.saveNote: Saving asks for your passkey, and the change is in the audit log with who made it.
console.agents.settings.saved: Saved for every bank. {name} runs this way from its next run.
console.agents.settings.errorTitle: Could not load how this agent runs

console.agents.runs.emptyBody: A run appears here as soon as this agent starts one.
